title: or-dashboards pages/<name>/visuals/<visual>.yml
description: One visual binding. `type` selects which factory in VISUAL_REGISTRY renders it; `metric` is the semantic-layer measure to bind to. Other keys are visual-specific overrides.

type.description: Visual type — must be a key in VISUAL_REGISTRY. The allowed set is enforced at validate time from the live registry, not from this schema.

filter.description: Filter passed to semantic_query. Keys are entity / dimension names; values are the filter value.
